title: Explicit degree-zero Picard cup-product transpose
statement: Let f:X→S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], E an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and j:W→S. Write p:X_W→W and q:X_W→X, with tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], direct image and its canonical adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and dual E=Hom(E,O_X) [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Suppose the adjunction unit at O_W is invertible. Define φ:p_*q^*(dual E)→dual(p_*q^*E) by transposing cup product. Explicitly, transport the tensor and unit comparisons of ordinary pullback to tensor pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. Pull evaluation E⊗dual E→O_X to X_W. Compose it with the two evaluation counits and the tensor comparison to obtain p^*(p_*q^*E⊗p_*q^*(dual E))→O_X_W. Take its adjoint, compose with the pushforward of the inverse unit comparison and the inverse adjunction unit at O_W, and curry. More generally the same construction pushes any pairing M⊗D→O_X_W forward. Pulling this pushed pairing back and composing with the unit comparison recovers evaluation of the two counits.

def picardCupProductMap {X S W : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (E : X.Modules) (j : W ⟶ S)
    (hO : IsIso ((Classical.choose
      (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f j))).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf))) :
    ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f j)).obj
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f j)).obj (Modules.dual E))) ⟶
    Modules.dual ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f j)).obj
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f j)).obj E))
